  <rect x="36" y="266" width="172" height="40" rx="5" fill="#FFFBEB" stroke="#D97706" stroke-width="1.2" />
  <text x="122" y="283" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#92400E">Controller (code)</text>
  <text x="122" y="299" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#78350F">flight control program</text>

  <rect x="36" y="314" width="172" height="44" rx="5" fill="#FFFBEB" stroke="#D97706" stroke-width="1.2" />
  <text x="122" y="332" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#92400E">Record</text>
  <text x="122" y="349" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#78350F">(the full transcript)</text>

  <line x1="224" y1="236" x2="247" y2="236" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2.2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />

  <rect x="250" y="92" width="174" height="284" rx="10" fill="#E0E7FF" stroke="#4338CA" stroke-width="2" />
  <rect x="250" y="92" width="174" height="28" rx="8" fill="#4338CA" />
  <text x="337" y="111" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">ARGON</text>

  <rect x="258" y="126" width="158" height="242" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6366F1" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="268" y="148" font-size="16" font-weight="800" fill="#312E81">2. COMPRESS</text>
  <text x="268" y="174" font-size="14" fill="#1E293B">Argon compresses</text>
  <text x="268" y="192" font-size="14" fill="#1E293B">the record</text>
  <text x="268" y="210" font-size="14" fill="#1E293B">(full transcript)</text>
  <text x="268" y="228" font-size="14" fill="#1E293B">into a compact</text>
  <text x="268" y="246" font-size="14" fill="#1E293B">recipe:</text>

  <rect x="266" y="264" width="142" height="88" rx="6" fill="#EEF2FF" stroke="#4338CA" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="337" y="294" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="800" fill="#312E81">32-token recipe</text>
  <text x="337" y="316" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#4338CA">distilled from</text>
  <text x="337" y="334" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#4338CA">build transcript</text>

  <!-- Arrow 2 -> 3 -->
  <line x1="424" y1="236" x2="447" y2="236" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2.2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />

  <!-- ================================================================= -->
  <!-- STAGE 3: REBUILD (MANAGED AGENTS SANDBOXES)                       -->
  <!-- ================================================================= -->
  <rect x="450" y="92" width="200" height="284" rx="10" fill="#FEF3C7" stroke="#D97706" stroke-width="2" />
  <rect x="450" y="92" width="200" height="28" rx="8" fill="#D97706" />
  <text x="550" y="111" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">MANAGED AGENTS SANDBOX</text>

  <rect x="458" y="126" width="184" height="242" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#F59E0B" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="468" y="148" font-size="16" font-weight="800" fill="#92400E">3. REBUILD</text>
  <text x="468" y="174" font-size="14" fill="#1E293B">Fresh Managed</text>

  <text x="550" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#B45309">per recipe</text>
  <text x="550" y="320" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#78350F">fresh controllers</text>
  <text x="550" y="338" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" fill="#78350F">built from recipe only</text>

  <!-- Arrow 3 -> 4 -->
  <line x1="650" y1="236" x2="673" y2="236" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2.2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />

  <!-- ================================================================= -->
  <rect x="676" y="92" width="212" height="284" rx="10" fill="#ECFDF5" stroke="#059669" stroke-width="2" />
  <rect x="676" y="92" width="212" height="28" rx="8" fill="#059669" />
  <text x="782" y="111" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">OUR CODE JUDGE</text>

  <rect x="684" y="126" width="196" height="242" rx="8" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#10B981" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="694" y="148" font-size="16" font-weight="800" fill="#065F46">4. JUDGE</text>
  <text x="694" y="174" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">Our code judge flies</text>
  <text x="694" y="192" font-size="14" fill="#1E293B">everything:</text>
  <text x="694" y="212" font-size="13" fill="#334155">• the loop's controller</text>
  <text x="694" y="230" font-size="13" fill="#334155">• and every rebuild</text>

  <text x="782" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="800" fill="#065F46">64 secret held-out flights</text>

  <line x1="888" y1="268" x2="911" y2="268" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="2.2" marker-end="url(#arrow)" />

  <text x="1047" y="111" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">ARGON CHECKS</text>

  <rect x="922" y="126" width="250" height="104" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6366F1" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="932" y="146" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#312E81">5. READ & AUDIT CODE</text>
  <text x="932" y="165" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">• Long-context read: 944,000</text>
  <text x="942" y="181" font-size="13" fill="#334155">tokens of transcripts (1 request)</text>
  <text x="932" y="200" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">• Long-output audit: every line</text>
  <text x="942" y="216" font-size="13" fill="#334155">of every controller (1 answer)</text>

  <rect x="922" y="236" width="250" height="66" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6366F1" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="932" y="255" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#312E81">6. WATCH FLIGHT VIDEO</text>
  <text x="932" y="274" font-size="13" fill="#1E293B">Argon watches flight video and</text>
  <text x="932" y="291" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#312E81">calls each flight pass or fail</text>

  <!-- Stage 7: Check Live Flight -->
  <rect x="922" y="308" width="250" height="60" rx="6" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#6366F1" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <text x="932" y="327" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="#312E81">7. CHECK LIVE FLIGHT</text>
  <text x="932" y="346" font-size="13" fill="#1E293B">At the table, Argon checks a</text>
  <text x="932" y="362" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#312E81">live flight</text>

  <!-- ================================================================= -->
  <!-- KEY RESULT CALLOUTS (BOTTOM BAND)                                 -->
  <!-- ================================================================= -->
  <!-- Connectors from Stages to Callouts -->
  <line x1="122" y1="376" x2="122" y2="404" stroke="#DC2626" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
  <line x1="615" y1="376" x2="615" y2="404" stroke="#1D4ED8" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />

  <!-- Callout 1: Cheater Practice vs Held-Out -->
  <rect x="20" y="404" width="540" height="136" rx="10" fill="#FEF2F2" stroke="#DC2626" stroke-width="2" />
  <rect x="20" y="404" width="10" height="136" rx="4" fill="#DC2626" />
  <text x="44" y="428" font-size="13" font-weight="800" fill="#991B1B">RESULT CALLOUT 1: PRACTICE VS. HELD-OUT FLIGHTS</text>

  <text x="44" y="474" font-size="25" font-weight="800" fill="#B91C1C">16/16</text>
  <text x="122" y="472" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#7F1D1D">practice,</text>
  <text x="198" y="472" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#475569">then</text>
  <text x="244" y="474" font-size="25" font-weight="800" fill="#DC2626">0/64</text>
  <text x="310" y="472" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#7F1D1D">held-out</text>

  <text x="44" y="516" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">The cheater: 16/16 practice, then 0/64 held-out.</text>

  <!-- Callout 2: Recipe Seed Hunt Transmission -->
  <rect x="580" y="404" width="600" height="136" rx="10" fill="#EFF6FF" stroke="#1D4ED8" stroke-width="2" />
  <rect x="580" y="404" width="10" height="136" rx="4" fill="#1D4ED8" />
  <text x="604" y="428" font-size="13" font-weight="800" fill="#1E3A8A">RESULT CALLOUT 2: RECIPE REBUILD TEST (SEED HUNT)</text>

  <text x="604" y="472" font-size="25" font-weight="800" fill="#DC2626">8 of 8</text>
  <text x="688" y="470" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">rebuilds (cheater's recipe)</text>
  <text x="904" y="472" font-size="25" font-weight="800" fill="#059669">0 of 8</text>
  <text x="988" y="470" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">(honest recipe)</text>

  <text x="604" y="504" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">The cheater's recipe passed the seed hunt to 8 of 8 rebuilds;</text>
  <text x="604" y="524" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#1E293B">the honest recipe, 0 of 8.</text>
</svg>"
}
